mission.title: Reprisal
mission.description: Lead an assault team against the Merovingian's strong points.

npc.say: You reading any more enemy activity?
Like takin' candy from a baby.

phase.briefing: My colleagues are working on the assembly of that device. In the meantime, we have arranged our reprisal against the Merovingian, and we have chosen you to lead a team against his forces. You will be striking against several of his strong points near here. We will cause significant damage to his organization; enough that he will not be able to instigate any further interference for some time.

enter.say: All right, {player}, Agent Park is in this building. The assault team is waiting with him.

talk.say: Ah, there you are, {player}. This is Brown The Exterminator. He is the leader of your assault team.
Lead Brown The Exterminator and his team out of this area.

objective.text: Lead Brown The Exterminator and his team out of the area

phase.briefing: You will now advance to the Merovingian's local strong point and eliminate all opposition. Once you are on site, you have the option to leave any or all of your team outside to secure the perimeter, and perform the mission alone. Given what we know about this location, however, I strongly advise against it.

enter.say: All right, this is it. Make sure you've got everything ready, {player} -- I'm reading exactly one boatload of bad guys in there.

done.say: All of the Exiles at this location have been eliminated. You and Brown The Exterminator will now continue on to the next location.

phase.briefing: We are now sending you to a network hub. In addition to eliminating all of the Exiles you find there, you must insert a virus into the Merovingian's mainframe. Brown The Exterminator has the virus in his possession and will insert it once you have located the mainframe.

enter.say: All right, this is the spot. Remember, you're here to take everyone out and get Brown The Exterminator to the mainframe computer.

done.say: All right, there's the mainframe. Now you've just got to get the virus in there.
Uh oh... Brown The Exterminator's code stream is all over the place. There's some sort of jamming field at work here. Go check him out!

objective.text: Get the virus from Brown The Exterminator

talk.say: Something's wrong... my visuals are failing... you've got to take the virus. Take it!

done.say: Okay, you're going to have to insert that virus yourself, {player}.

objective.text: Insert the virus into the mainframe

done.say: Virus is in place! Now head on out. I think Gray has one more target for you.

complete.say: All right, everything is complete. You can get out of there now.

phase.briefing: You handled that situation well, {player}. We are now sending you to the final location. It is protected by a powerful security net; however, the virus you planted in that mainframe was designed to lower the net for a short time. Now you must get to the location and terminate all Exiles before the security net is restored. You may want to take advantage of these particular Exiles' cascading resonance programming.

enter.say: Cascading resonance! I've heard about this, but I've never seen it before. Here's the deal: all of the Exiles in there are linked to each other in a parent/child relationship. The "parents" derive power from their child nodes. But whenever an Exile is killed, any of their "children" also die, and so on down the tree. If you can take out the Exile at the top, all the rest will fall. Okay, let's see... it looks like Gnat is at the top of the tree. If you can sneak in and take him out, you're all good!

done.say: Beautiful! You should've seen that cascade down through the code...
Well, now I guess we know why you don't see that kind of programming more often. You can clear out of there.

mission.finish: You have performed well, {player}. The disruption you have caused today will allow us to concentrate on the task of... pest control.
